title: Choose my next task
description: Find what needs your attention and work through it.
example: What should I focus on today?

title: Sync the latest updates
description: Bring recent updates from your connected tools into shared knowledge.
example: Sync recent updates from my connected tools.

title: Prepare for a meeting
description: Get a sourced brief on a person, company or topic.
example: Help me prepare for my next customer meeting.

title: Ask or remember something
description: Use saved knowledge and keep new findings with their sources.
example: What do we know about our target customers?

title: Add a file
description: Put a PDF, image or deck in the brain, attached to who it belongs to, with its content noted.
example: Add this deck to the brain for Acme.

title: Work in a project
description: Create a project folder, or link an existing one to your brain.
example: Create a new project for our website.

title: Set up or resume GTM OS
description: Start onboarding or continue from the last saved step.

title: Change my preferences
description: Adjust workplace information, language or dashboard preferences.
example: Help me change my GTM OS preferences.

title: Make a skill of your own
description: Turn a repeated workflow into a Codex skill kept in this brain, or install one from GitHub.
example: Turn what we just did into a skill.

title: Keep the brand guidelines
description: Tone of voice, design system, target customer definition: the documents Codex follows before writing copy or designing.
example: Add our tone of voice from the website and the last deck.
